verdict.rationale: There is direct evidence of an official Atlassian MCP server (covering Bitbucket as part of the Atlassian suite) documented on GitHub, which allows AI agents to connect via MCP. However, the evidence is a single probe citation with no detailed documentation on setup, scope of Bitbucket-specific tools, or independent hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs describing Bitbucket-specific MCP tool coverage, and independent/community corroboration of real-world usage.
